steps.text: Speak to Charlie in the Ardougne Zoo.
choices: Ah, you sound like someone who needs a quest doing!
Sure.  Any idea where I should start looking?

steps.text: Go to the camp north of Eagles' Peak and search the pile of books for a Bird Book. The closest fairy ring is AKQ or teleport to The Outpost using the Necklace of Passage.
Click the Bird Book for a Metal Feather.
Go to the camp north of Eagles' Peak and search the pile of books to get the Metal Feather back.
Use the Metal Feather on the Rocky Outcrop on Eagles' Peak.
Enter Eagles' Peak through the Rocky Outcrop.
Shout to Nickolaus from across the chasm.
choices: The Ardougne zookeeper sent me to find you.
Well if you gave me a ferret I could take it back for you.

steps.text: Pick up 10 Eagle feathers from the piles in the main cavern.
Go speak to Asyff in south-east Varrock to have a disguise made.
choices: Well, specifically I'm after a couple of bird costumes.

steps.text: Speak to Asyff again.
choices: I've got the feathers and materials you requested.
Okay, here are the materials. Eagle me up.
